_: Eternal Starlight, from All the Mods 10's census (W4 R9, judged 2026-11-12). Named one by one, only the blocks that census saw as ground and judged, because a word a rule could read would take other mods' blocks with it, and because a file reaches a config that already holds detection's line where a changed rule does not. Their bricks, tiles, polished forms, slabs, stairs, walls and carpets were not judged and are left to the rules, their ores and crystal blocks are excluded, and the Starlight's grimstone, voidstone, sands, gravels, ices, dirts and grass blocks that detection already places are left to it.

Stone: glacite, stellagmite and molten stellagmite are the Starlight's natural rock, twilight sandstone its desert's, and the cryobyssal and thermabyssal magma blocks the hot rock of its seas, not the Nether's; the rules leave them out for having no stone word, or for the decorative word in sandstone. Grass: the blue and red crystal moss blocks, the cave moss block, velvetumoss and red velvetumoss are living tops over its ground, as the game's moss block is, on a material no rule reads; the glowing mossy dusted gravel is judged by its moss top too, where the rules read gravel in its name. Dirt: nightfall mud, glowing nightfall mud and packed nightfall mud are the floor of its swamps and shores and wear as mud does; the first two are short of their cell, as the game's mud is, which the rules refuse.

A slab or stair takes its full block's ruling (Xep, 2026-11-13: Can we make it so all slabs of blocks that wear, also wear, in their own like the full blocks do? and: Same with stairs as slabs; W4 R15). These are this mod's slabs and stairs whose full blocks a census of 1.21.1 judged, each named at its full block's family so it wears on its own texture as the full block does. A slab or stair of a block the census excluded, or never judged, is left as it was. Where an earlier note here leaves this mod's slabs and stairs to the rules, or to detection's family, the ones named below no longer are.
